reviews.comment: Dr Kang is a nice man but is incredibly unorganized. His lectures are slow and are mind numbingly boring. He does an abysmal job of explaining any assignment and grades you as if you were a professional and his TA's are equally frustrating, marking many correct assignment answers wrong. If you have a chance to take someone else for COSC 175 do that

He hates being asked questions and it is obvious that the TA and him do not communicate about grading criterias. However, I did enjoy going to class because it was funny watching him get upset at the smallest things.

Professor expects professional quality out of a class of beginners. Goes over very important instructions quickly and gives no time in class to work on projects. Students were required to provide their own construction drawings for projects in Revit and Navisworks. Mostly learning on the fly and searching YouTube for better instruction.
This professor is bad at giving instructions and teaching how to use Sketchup for a class project. The main plus is that his grades are straightforward.

Using BIM applications is pretty fun, but don't plan on asking Kang for help or getting feedback with Revit or NavisWorks. Requires attendance but does not allow you to work on group projects in the class. Often made us put our laptops up too, so you couldn't take notes about the assignment. Evident he cares about research more than teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader
